title: Spec Kit: Github's NEW tool That FINALLY Fixes AI Coding
summary: Better Stack demo of GitHub Spec Kit's specify/plan/tasks/implement flow building a small app.

assertions.quote: Specdriven development eliminates that guesswork. It gives AI clear structured guidance

verdicts.note: Clear requirements, examples and references reliably improve agent output; the caveat is that bloated context can hurt, so curation matters.

assertions.quote: the spec becomes the authorative artifact and the models constantly circle back to the spec document

verdicts.note: Specs help align agents, but code is still what runs; specs drift from implementation unless continuously maintained, and practitioners like Pocock report specs-only workflows failing.

assertions.quote: You can review each change before implementation instead of running bulky code dumps

verdicts.note: Small batches with fast feedback are a strong DORA predictor of delivery performance; DORA 2024 linked AI to larger batches and lower stability.

assertions.quote: choosing the right coding model is still necessary to achieve the best results

verdicts.note: Model strengths do differ by task in benchmarks and practice, but the specific pairing is personal preference and shifts each release.
